estimands.main_effect: For each feature i and target t, average [percentile(S union {i}) - percentile(S)] over all 511 non-empty subsets S of the other nine feature families.
estimands.pairwise_interaction: For each pair i,j and target t, average [p(S union {i,j}) - p(S union {i}) - p(S union {j}) + p(S)] over all 255 non-empty subsets S of the remaining eight feature families.

hypothesis: Within the fixed Q7 1,023-formula subset grammar, individual feature families and selected pairs have stable marginal or interaction effects on the strict-prior percentile rank of the realized quintet.

inference.correction: Holm-Bonferroni across all 55 registered Blind OOS endpoints
inference.global_research_family_correction: Not covered; prior Q00-Q141 exploration remains an exposure and multiplicity limitation.
inference.method: two-sided block sign-flip over consecutive non-overlapping blocks; circular moving-block bootstrap confidence interval
inference.null: zero main or pairwise interaction effect
inference.practical_gate: Flag only if Holm-adjusted p<0.05 and absolute mean effect>=0.005 percentile units.

limitations: Q7 is a quintet_score grammar; effects are not comparable to per-number Q80/Q90 scores.
Main and pairwise effects are descriptive factorial rank contrasts, not causal effects and not a deployable predictor.
The fixed Q7 grammar contains 1,023 masks over ten feature families; conclusions do not cover all possible formulas.
Historical Blind OOS is exposed prior SONAR research history, not virgin prospective evidence.
Holm correction covers the 55 registered B9 endpoints only, not the full Q00-Q141 research family.
The source archive ends on 2026-10-24; later Q141 suffix rows and contest 315 are excluded.
The Blind OOS segment contains 657 targets and 33 non-overlapping blocks of length 20; block inference remains dependent on the registered sign-flip assumptions.
next_action: If no effects are flagged, stop adding Q7-only interaction variants and proceed to the cross-granularity behaviour atlas while preserving Q7 quintet_score separately from Q80/Q90 per-number_score. If any endpoint is flagged, preregister an independent replication before any selector or engine use.

walkforward.target_cutoff_rule: Each rank row's cutoff is exactly the immediately preceding Q7 archive date; score/write precedes add_draw(state) in the pinned runner.
walkforward.target_outcome_role: The realized quintet is only the evaluation label for the already-frozen strict-prior rank vector.
